command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
export PATH=${CONDA_PREFIX:-/opt/conda}/bin:$PATH TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp LC_ALL=C
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /tmp/out
echo "d2199add14b49002fbfe25e0d574b0f01f2486a70b7d472a23632002c5a1e48d  /tmp/pin.py" | sha256sum -c - || { echo "FAIL: pin.py does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
echo "9143f202f46c0fe7e235590adbd78e9a912008abd216657dc4bdf17c610827e6  /tmp/scenes.txt" | sha256sum -c - || { echo "FAIL: scenes.txt does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
T0=$(date +%s)
python3 -u pin.py /tmp/scenes.txt /tmp/items /tmp/out 32 > /tmp/out/pin.log 2>&1
RC=$?
echo "pin.py exit $RC in $(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))s" | tee -a /tmp/out/pin.log
cat /tmp/out/pin.log
test "$RC" = 0 && grep -q 'PIN OK' /tmp/out/pin.log || { echo "FAIL: pin.py"; exit 1; }
test "$(wc -l < /tmp/out/pins-data.sha256)" -eq 612 || { echo "FAIL: want 612 pins"; exit 1; }
echo DONE
